run_WGANGPGradientPenalty: run the WGANGPGradientPenalty function to compute a gradient penalty for WGAN-GP training
run_logisticGradientPenalty: run the logisticGradientPenalty function to compute a gradient penalty for logistic GAN training
create_WGANGP_gradient_penalty: create a WGAN-GP gradient penalty by interpolating real and fake data through a discriminator
create_logistic_gradient_penalty: create a logistic gradient penalty by computing the squared gradient norm of real data
refactor_gradient_losses: refactor the gradient loss functions to use modern PyTorch tensor operations instead of autograd.Variable
